propositions: Current per-extra matrix jobs (5 cells) plus union job consume 6 concurrent slots; org limit of 20 total slots prevents full parallelization of 21-slot Verified runs, causing 8-9 minute slot wait times that inflate total run duration from 21m to 41-47m
Five per-extra matrix entries do not align with _optional.EXTRAS keys: mcp lacks detection probe and is not in EXTRAS, while metrics is in EXTRAS but has no per-extra CI lane today

Collapsing per-extra and union jobs into a single venv-loop job running seven isolated iterations (one per EXTRAS key plus mcp, plus one union run) reduces peak concurrent slots from 6 to 1 while preserving isolation validation and joint dependency resolution

Loop must invoke all interpreters and console scripts by absolute venv path (never bare python/rebar-mcp), contain no source activate statements, use rc accumulator with continue guards, and exit non-zero on any iteration failure to prevent silent-pass footguns
Checked-in tests must assert loop step contains exit rc and continue with no activate, and assert looped extras cover all _optional.EXTRAS keys to block future extras shipping with zero CI

Hard-coded check names in infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json name jobs being deleted; stale snapshot would freeze main on emergency rollback despite Terraform ruleset declaring no required status checks
